identity.title: [v0.92][Runtime] Wire governed Adaptive Learning into resident execution

values.review_scope: Design/readiness review for #449 governed Adaptive Learning resident integration, including dependency gates, actual resident-cycle proof target, and non-overlap with #446.
review_prompts: Verify that #449 keeps MutationGate as the only mutation authority.
Verify that capability/profile handles are dependency-gated production inputs and not fabricated.
Verify that #446 ACC tool-actuation concerns remain out of scope.
Verify that the planned proof exercises an actual resident cycle and restart rather than only library tests.
Verify that evidence/observability avoids private profile/provider leakage.
residual_risk: Full AC2 production binding remains dependency-gated until sibling capability/profile handles are terminal.
